data.long_description:
Discover the epitome of luxury living at Canal Heights, an exclusive development by Damac Properties in Business Bay. Offering a range of stylish studios and expansive 1-2 bedroom apartments, each unit is designed with precision, using top-quality materials and cutting-edge appliances for a perfect blend of comfort and sophistication.

Residents are spoiled with exceptional amenities, including a beautifully designed swimming pool, a state-of-the-art gym, lush recreational and BBQ areas, children’s playgrounds, and secure underground parking. With concierge services and round-the-clock security, Canal Heights ensures a seamless lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most dynamic neighborhoods. Its prime location also grants residents easy access to the canal walkway, dining options, business hubs, and entertainment venues.

Canal Heights is ideally positioned for swift access to key destinations, with Dubai Mall just 5 minutes away, Jumeirah Beach and the iconic Burj Al Arab a mere 15-minute drive, and Dubai Marina and Palm Jumeirah reachable in 25 minutes.

Flexible financing available. Contact us at +97143233609 for more details or to arrange a consultation.
